```
# Actions
- draining canary pods
- deploying v2.14.6 to prod-eu2
- updating routing rules
```
sara: pinning traffic to v2.14.6 for prod-eu2 until postmortem. doing a manual route pin now.
release-manager: noting: revert due to KV cache format regression. change window extended; will update release notes and notify customers on dedicated contracts.
deploybot: Revert-deploy completed on prod-eu2 — duration 3m12s — status: success. All canary and main routes back on v2.14.6.
ops-oncall: verified: 5xx rate back to baseline, p95 latency normalized. continuing 15m watch. :thumbsup:
jia: opening PR with fix + canary-only feature-flag to avoid KV format changes without rollout gating. linking PR in release notes. cc @release-manager
deploybot: Pin applied: `deploybot pin --env=prod-eu2 --tag=v2.14.6 --reason="post-rollback stabilization"`
mike: thanks everyone. scheduling a short postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT to cover root cause & next steps.
release-manager: I'll draft the customer-facing blurb and coordinate comms for impacted enterprise accounts.
sara: leaving monitoring hooks on and will escalate if we see any regressions.
